name: @divvun/hfst
description: Divvun HFST for JavaScript: reads optimized-lookup transducers, pmatch containers and DHFST spellers and runs lookup, tokenisation and DHFST acceptor lookup, and its @divvun/hfst/compile entry point compiles, transforms, inspects and writes transducers as the hfst tools do. WebAssembly for browsers, Web Workers, Deno, Node and Bun. It replaces hfst-js for reading and looking up transducers.
author: UiT The Arctic University of Norway
